mapper.select:
SELECT b.TOUR_ID,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.TOUR_NM, ''), b.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.TOUR_NM, ''), b.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM, b.TOUR_NM,
c1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM, c2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.ROAD_ADDR, ''), b.ROAD_ADDR) AS ROAD_ADDR, COALESCE(NULLIF(en.DETAIL_ADDR, ''), b.DETAIL_ADDR) AS DETAIL_ADDR,
COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.ROAD_ADDR, ''), b.ROAD_ADDR) AS ROAD_ADDR, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.DETAIL_ADDR, ''), b.DETAIL_ADDR) AS DETAIL_ADDR,
b.ROAD_ADDR, b.DETAIL_ADDR,
b.ZIP_CD, d.CATE_CD, d.CATE_NM, IFNULL(a.AVG_SCORE,0) AS AVG_SCORE,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.FIRST_IMAGE, ''), b.FIRST_IMAGE) AS FIRST_IMAGE, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.FIRST_IMAGE, ''), b.FIRST_IMAGE) AS FIRST_IMAGE, b.FIRST_IMAGE,
b.TOUR_NM_EN, b.TOUR_NM_JA,
(CASE WHEN en.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN (CASE WHEN jp.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN 'N' AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN
FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOUR_ID, AVG(REVIEW_SCORE) AS AVG_SCORE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW GROUP BY TOUR_ID ) a ON b.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tc.TOUR_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(tc.CATE_CD ORDER BY tc.CATE_CD) AS CATE_CD, GROUP_CONCAT(cd.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY cd.CMM_CM_NM) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE tc LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D cd ON tc.CATE_CD = cd.CMM_CDV AND cd.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' GROUP BY tc.TOUR_ID ) d ON b.TOUR_ID = d.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D c1 ON CONCAT(b.SIDO_CD,'00000000') = c1.CMM_CDV AND c1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D c2 ON CONCAT(b.SIDO_CD,b.SGG_CD,'00000') = c2.CMM_CDV AND c2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_EN_LIST en ON b.TOUR_ID = en.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_JP_LIST jp ON b.TOUR_ID = jp.TOUR_ID WHERE b.USE_YN='Y'
AND ( b.TOUR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.TOUR_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.ROAD_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c1.CMM_CM_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c2.CMM_CM_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND d.CATE_CD = #{cateCd}
AND ( b.ROAD_ADDR IS NULL OR b.TOUR_ID = ( SELECT MIN(b2.TOUR_ID) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b2 WHERE b2.ROAD_ADDR = b.ROAD_ADDR AND b2.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ) ORDER BY AVG_SCORE DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.TOUR_ID, a.TOUR_NM, a.TOUR_CONTENT, b1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM, b2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM, a.ROAD_ADDR, a.DETAIL_ADDR, a.ZIP_CD, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.CATE_CD ORDER BY c.CATE_CD) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_CD,
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY d.CMM_CM_NM) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D d ON c.CATE_CD = d.CMM_CDV AND d.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b1 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,'00000000') = b1.CMM_CDV AND b1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b2 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,a.SGG_CD,'00000') = b2.CMM_CDV AND b2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' WHERE a.TOUR_ID = #{tourId}

SELECT a.TOUR_ID,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.FIRST_IMAGE, ''), a.FIRST_IMAGE) AS FIRST_IMAGE, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.FIRST_IMAGE, ''), a.FIRST_IMAGE) AS FIRST_IMAGE, a.FIRST_IMAGE,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.TOUR_NM, ''), a.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.TOUR_NM, ''), a.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM, a.TOUR_NM,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.TOUR_CONTENT, ''), a.TOUR_CONTENT) AS TOUR_CONTENT, COALESCE(NULLIF(en.TOUR_CONTENT, ''), a.TOUR_CONTENT) AS OVERVIEW,
COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.TOUR_CONTENT, ''), a.TOUR_CONTENT) AS TOUR_CONTENT, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.TOUR_CONTENT, ''), a.TOUR_CONTENT) AS OVERVIEW,
a.TOUR_CONTENT, a.TOUR_CONTENT AS OVERVIEW,
a.MAP_Y AS LATITUDE, a.MAP_X AS LONGITUDE, a.TOUR_NM_EN, a.TOUR_NM_JA, a.TOUR_CONTENT_EN AS OVERVIEW_EN, a.TOUR_CONTENT_JA AS OVERVIEW_JA, b1.CMM_CDV AS SIDO_CD, b1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM, b2.CMM_CDV AS SGG_CD, b2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM,
COALESCE(NULLIF(en.ROAD_ADDR, ''), a.ROAD_ADDR) AS ROAD_ADDR, COALESCE(NULLIF(en.DETAIL_ADDR, ''), a.DETAIL_ADDR) AS DETAIL_ADDR,
COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.ROAD_ADDR, ''), a.ROAD_ADDR) AS ROAD_ADDR, COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.DETAIL_ADDR, ''), a.DETAIL_ADDR) AS DETAIL_ADDR,
a.ROAD_ADDR, a.DETAIL_ADDR,
a.ROAD_ADDR_EN, a.ROAD_ADDR_JA, a.DETAIL_ADDR_EN, a.DETAIL_ADDR_JA, a.ZIP_CD, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.CATE_CD ORDER BY c.CATE_CD) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_CD,
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY d.CMM_CM_NM) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D d ON c.CATE_CD = d.CMM_CDV AND d.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_NM, IFNULL(c.AVG_SCORE,0) AS AVG_SCORE,
(CASE WHEN en.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN (CASE WHEN jp.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN 'N' AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN
FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b1 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,'00000000') = b1.CMM_CDV AND b1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b2 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,a.SGG_CD,'00000') = b2.CMM_CDV AND b2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOUR_ID, AVG(REVIEW_SCORE) AS AVG_SCORE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW GROUP BY TOUR_ID ) c ON a.TOUR_ID = c.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_EN_LIST en ON a.TOUR_ID = en.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_JP_LIST jp ON a.TOUR_ID = jp.TOUR_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.TOUR_ID = #{tourId}

SELECT b.TOUR_ID
,COALESCE(NULLIF(en.TOUR_NM, ''), b.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM ,COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.TOUR_NM, ''), b.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM ,b.TOUR_NM
,b.TOUR_NM_EN ,b.TOUR_NM_JA
,(CASE WHEN en.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN ,(CASE WHEN jp.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN ,'N' AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN
FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_EN_LIST en ON b.TOUR_ID = en.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_JP_LIST jp ON b.TOUR_ID = jp.TOUR_ID WHERE b.TOUR_ID IN
#{tourId}

SELECT a.REVIEW_ID , b.MOIM_TITLE , b.MOIM_START_DT , b.MOIM_END_DT , a.REVIEW_TITLE , a.REVIEW_CONTENT , a.REVIEW_TITLE_EN , a.REVIEW_TITLE_JA , a.REVIEW_CONTENT_EN , a.REVIEW_CONTENT_JA , a.REVIEW_SCORE , a.IMG_URLS , a.CREATE_DT , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(c.USER_NM) = 1 THEN '*' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(c.USER_NM) = 2 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(c.USER_NM, 1), '*') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(c.USER_NM, 1), '***', RIGHT(c.USER_NM, 1)) END AS USER_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST b ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO c ON a.CREATE_USER = c.USER_ID WHERE a.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'T' AND a.TOUR_ID = #{tourId} ORDER BY a.CREATE_DT DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT OPERATING_HOURS ,CLOSED_DAYS ,ADMISSION_FEE_IS_FREE ,ADMISSION_FEE_DETAILS ,WEBSITE_URL ,PARKING_AVAILABLE ,PARKING_FEE_INFO ,LAST_UPDATED_NOTE FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_AI_INFO WHERE TOUR_ID = #{tourId} AND LANG_CD = #{langCd}
